name: Profile evaluation
short: Find out which countries, courses and universities fit your marks, budget and goals.

meta.title: Free profile evaluation for studying abroad
meta.description: A counsellor checks your marks, backlogs, English score, work experience and budget, then tells you which countries and universities fit. Free, at any Wayfarer branch or by phone.

h1: A profile evaluation tells you where you can realistically apply.
intro: A counsellor looks at your marks, gaps, English score and budget, and gives you a shortlist of countries and universities that fit. It is free.
covers: Your academic record: 10th, 12th or degree marks, backlogs and study gaps
English test status, or whether you need a test at all
Work experience and how it helps or affects your application
Your total budget, including what an education loan can cover
Countries and intakes that suit your timeline
A first shortlist of courses and universities
whoFor: 12th class students planning a bachelor's degree abroad
Graduates planning a master's or MBA
Working professionals with a study gap
Students with backlogs who want to know their options

steps.title: Answer seven questions
steps.text: Start the free profile check online, or call your nearest branch.

steps.title: Talk to a counsellor
steps.text: A counsellor calls you, or you meet at the branch with your marks memos.

steps.title: Get your shortlist
steps.text: You get the countries, courses and universities that fit, with fees and intakes.

steps.title: Decide your next step
steps.text: Book a test, start applications, or take time to plan with your family.

faq.a: Yes. There is no charge for the profile check or the first counselling session.

faq.q: What should I bring to the branch?
faq.a: Your marks memos, passport if you have one, any English test score, and an idea of your family's budget.

faq.q: I have backlogs. Can I still study abroad?
faq.a: Many universities accept students with backlogs, but the rules differ by country and university. Your counsellor checks the rules for each university on your shortlist.
